title: Implement the campaign navigation shell and scoped routes

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

body:
Implementation parent: [Militia UI rework](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148) · Original planning map: [UI rework decisions](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) · Authoring task: [Write this area spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/123).

When creating implementation tickets from this spec, follow the [source traceability requirements](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/148#source-traceability-and-future-tickets): link back to this spec and carry forward the relevant decision-comment permalinks, amendments, pinned prototypes and capability IDs from the sections below.

## 1. Scope and ownership

Deliver the campaign navigation shell as **rollout position 1 of 12**, with the current live editors working inside it. Players can navigate to a named campaign, its current week, Finished weeks, Militia, Characters & officers and Setup, including from existing bookmarks, without losing campaign context or any current editing capability.

This implementation issue is outside the [Rework the militia UI for ease of use](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/99) planning map. Its authoring task is [Write the Navigation shell implementation spec](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/123). Baseline inspected: main at `eef41f7bad19e63ecce858e7a4490c937a4ece89`.

Own the new route structure, one top bar, campaign and organization switching, account/sign-in controls, campaign section links, phone bottom navigation and More sheet, legacy redirects, campaign-level authorization/unavailable presentation, maintenance banner and reusable failed-load component. Keep theme tokens/fonts and prefer shadcn/ui primitives. Route components remain thin; isolate campaign access/navigation orchestration from page editors and existing backend writes.

The [Week frame authoring owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/124) owns the stepper, reference panel, phase readiness/footer, save/other-player feedback and Confirmation transition. Provide integration positions without duplicating its state or moving existing feedback out of reach. The [Setup owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/130), [Militia corrections owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/131), [Characters & officers owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/132), [Finished weeks owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/133) and [Campaign list/home owner](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/134) own their eventual page designs and layout skeletons. Their current contents remain usable until replacement delivery. This issue introduces no page redesign, new rules or backend contract.

## 2. Decision sources

Read these complete discussions; later approved amendments override older mock behavior:

- [What navigation structure should the live flow have? — resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831173561), including the [team-manager amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831430773).
- [How should loading, unavailable, failed and maintenance-pause states look across the new structure? — resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381).
- [How should the shell and week screen adapt to phone and desktop? — approved variant B](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929).
- [What should the campaign list and creation look like, and does a campaign get its own home view? — resolution](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/118#issuecomment-5846080538).
- [Should first-time setup and militia corrections be one workflow or two? — route and editor ownership amendment](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/103#issuecomment-5834024251).
- [How should the agreed designs be split into per-area spec issues, and in what order should they roll out? — common template and completion gate](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/122#issuecomment-5846600504).

Apply these precedence points explicitly: `/campaigns/<id>` is the selected-campaign list/home route, **not** the earlier proposed redirect to the week; every campaign section stays visible before militia setup, superseding the early two-tab shell; direct setup bookmarks for started militias show the later already-set-up state; `/militia/correct` is replaced by in-place corrections on `/militia`; team managers remain with teams. The old three-tab reference-panel mock is not this shell's content contract: Week frame owns the later now/after and This phase design. Shell and Week frame must not depend on the future finished-weeks listing query (rollout 11); keep current Finished weeks access and use only existing `canonicalHistory.read` where history data is needed before that delivery.

### Shell behavior acceptance

- **Tablet landscape (primary):** no app sidebar; slim top bar with Keep link, campaign switcher ending in **All campaigns…**, section links **Week N**, **Finished weeks**, **Militia**, **Characters & officers**, and organization/account controls on the right. The Week label can omit its number until known. Keep and All campaigns lead to `/campaigns`. Only the week mounts week-specific status/reference controls. Other sections use the page area without a week panel.
- **Phone:** below the prototype's `md` breakpoint (768px), retain the brand and campaign switcher above the page and place the four sections plus **More** in a bottom bar. More opens a shadcn sheet with organization and account/sign-in controls. Visual labels may shorten as the prototype does, but accessible names identify the full section. Reserve room for Week frame's status strip immediately above the bar. Content, alerts and editor save buttons must remain reachable above navigation, including safe areas and the on-screen keyboard. Close More on selection; restore focus on dismissal. No floating sidebar trigger remains.
- **Desktop:** at 1280px and above retain top navigation and give the week host bounded remaining viewport space so Week frame can implement its scrolling middle column with stepper rail and docked panel. Do not apply the future week-only no-page-scroll rule to all hosted legacy forms. Current forms remain scrollable; later non-week owners supply their own responsive page layouts.
- **Campaign list/root:** organization switcher occupies the breadcrumb position after Keep; account is on the right. Preserve the existing picker, create dialog/form and first-campaign default as a temporary scaffold. `/campaigns/<id>` selects that campaign in the same scaffold and exposes links to its current screens. Do not redirect the selected-campaign address to the week, silently select another campaign when an explicit id is unavailable, or implement the final home pane early. The list no longer embeds another copy of the week editor.
- **Campaign switching:** list only the active organization's campaigns. Put selection in the campaign route so refresh and browser Back/Forward retain the selected campaign. Campaign switching never carries an old campaign's history record id, query cache, pending editor state or draft identity into the new campaign. Selecting a campaign opens its selected-campaign route; the existing screen links then choose the section. Switching the active organization from a campaign page goes to `/campaigns` for the new organization.
- **Loading/access:** render the shell immediately with name/account skeletons while their data is pending. Once campaign access is resolved, section links remain ordinary links and work even if the page fails. Do not flash a stale campaign name or page from the previous organization while checking access.
- **Unavailable:** an invalid id, deleted campaign, non-member campaign or campaign outside the active organization has the same neutral campaign-level presentation replacing tabs/page: **This campaign isn't available in [active organization name].**, organization switcher and **Back to campaigns**. Keep brand, organization and account controls. If there is no selected organization, offer the organization chooser without inventing an organization name. Signed out, show **Sign in to open this campaign.** with **Sign in**. Preserve the requested destination through sign-in when supported by the existing auth flow. No automatic organization switching or existence disclosure.
- **Maintenance:** show **Campaign editing is paused for maintenance. Please try again shortly.** on the campaign list and every campaign section, including load/empty/error screens. Tablet/desktop places it under the top bar; the later approved phone treatment places it above the top bar. It does not replace readable content or disable edit controls. Writes still use existing failure feedback and the server's pause message.
- **Failed loads:** provide one accessible alert card with a page noun and **Try again**, whose callback retries that page's data. A page failure must not swallow the shell or prevent section navigation. Keep the message neutral; membership failure is the separate campaign-level state. Adopt this wrapper for current hosted page failures as they are adapted, retaining their retry behavior. Page-shaped skeletons and refined empty states belong to the named page owners; keep current readable loading status text for screen readers throughout.

## 3. Prototypes

| Purpose | Branch and pinned commit | Approved route / variant |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tablet navigation and section placement | [`prototype/navigation` at `76c4d9a4eccffc48d99fb55f8c64788c4ec2a6b8`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/76c4d9a4eccffc48d99fb55f8c64788c4ec2a6b8) | `/prototype/navigation?variant=E` — E, top bar plus docked reference panel |
| Phone shell and desktop host constraints | [`prototype/responsive-shell` at `de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7`](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/tree/de10f4208904ca583d0fbc143bfc6314f0b9c0e7) | `/prototype/responsive-shell?variant=B`; direct `/prototype/responsive-shell/screen?variant=B&phase=activity` — B, Bottom bar and sheets |

Run the prototype branch with `pnpm prototype`; do not merge either prototype or copy its mocked data/auth/status behavior into production. Review tablet landscape 1180×820 (plus the existing 1194×834 E2E viewport), phone 390×844 and landscape, and desktop 1440×900. The shared-state decision has no separate prototype. The later amendments in section 2, functional links instead of mock spans, existing editable pages during rollout, and real campaign/membership state are intentional differences from these pinned snapshots.

## 4. Capability accounting

`docs/ui-capability-inventory.md` remains the current-behavior inventory. Append planned coverage until implementation lands; update current locations and E2E evidence only when actually shipped. Every id below is explicitly retained, replaced with an approved equivalent, or shared with a named owner.

| Exact inventory id | This delivery's acceptance / coverage | Owner or handoff |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NAV-01 | Approved sidebar retirement; remove sidebar/rail UI without losing its destinations. Its remembered open/closed affordance moves to the week reference panel. Inventory currently marks the approved removal although main still renders the sidebar. | Shell removal; Week frame owns persistent panel visibility. |
| NAV-02 | Keep logo opens `/campaigns` on all shell layouts. | Shell; Campaign list/home reuses. |
| NAV-03 | Preserve the home-navigation function via `/` → `/campaigns` and Keep/All campaigns; the placeholder/My Keep destination is the explicitly approved replacement, not lost functionality. | Shell; Campaign list/home reuses. |
| NAV-04 | Campaign-list navigation stays reachable with active location communicated. | Shell. |
| NAV-05 | Sign in reachable when signed out, including phone More and protected destination state. | Shell. |
| NAV-06 | Organization control available throughout, properly filters selection and returns to campaign list on change. | Shell; Campaign list/home owns final list states. |
| NAV-07 | Account and sign-out retained in top bar/More. | Shell. |
| NAV-08 | Auth-loading text is replaced by accessible account skeleton. | Shell. |
| NAV-09 | Phone trigger's navigation reachability is replaced by bottom tabs and More. | Shell, approved responsive rearrangement. |
| NAV-10 | Finished weeks section link preserves selected campaign; temporary existing inline link may remain. | Shell route; Week frame owns reference-panel entry. |
| NAV-11 | Set up militia links from hosted no-militia Week/Militia resolve within this campaign. | Shell route; Week frame and Militia corrections own final empty pages. |
| NAV-12 | Return from history to this campaign's current week stays reachable through Week tab and existing link. | Shell; Finished weeks owns record-pane return CTA. |
| NAV-13 | Completed setup's Open week N works; later state also offers Open militia. | Shell route; Setup owns final started-militia page. |
| NAV-14 | Successful setup opens the same campaign's week at the requested valid phase. | Shell route integration; Setup owns initialization and collision behavior. |
| NAV-15 | All five phase URL values and invalid→Upkeep behavior retained; navigation remains player-local. | Shell parser/navigation bridge; Week frame owns interactive phase navigation and eligibility. |
| NAV-16 | Existing week and ledger functionality is reachable in the four campaign sections. | Shell temporary hosting; downstream page owners replace contents. |
| CAMP-01 | Active organization campaign picker and first-campaign default retained; top-bar switcher on campaign pages. | Shared with Campaign list/home, which owns final list rows. |
| CAMP-02 | Explicit route selection survives reload and campaign changes isolate content. | Shell route context; Campaign list/home owns final pane selection. |
| CAMP-03 | Existing create dialog remains reachable on `/campaigns` until the pane form replaces it. | Temporary shell reachability; Campaign list/home owns full capability and approved result-shape change. |
| CAMP-04 | Existing empty-organization create entry remains reachable. | Temporary shell reachability; Campaign list/home owns final empty layout. |
| CAMP-05 | Members see permitted campaign contents; outsiders and wrong-organization deep links cannot expose them. | Shell campaign gate; all page owners retain server-side authorization. |
| STATE-01 | Non-blocking maintenance banner on every hosted page and list. | Shell. |
| STATE-02 | Shell/account/name loading scaffold and readable current page loading states. | Shell; Campaign list/home owns list skeleton; each page owner owns its full skeleton. |
| STATE-03 | Shared failed-load card and page-local retry while navigation remains usable. | Shell component; Campaign list/home owns list failure; other owners supply their noun/retry. |
| STATE-04 | Organization chooser and campaign-level wrong-organization recovery. | Shell; Campaign list/home owns final no-organization/list-access presentation. |
| STATE-05 | Centralize campaign access decisions without losing current week/setup/history loading, retry and unavailable coverage. | Shell access boundary; Week frame, Setup and Finished weeks own page states. |
| STATE-06 | Reload and multi-device changes remain intact through routes and hosting. | Shared regression obligation of every owner. |
| WEEK-03 | Changing one player's phase URL or tab never changes another player's Phase View. | Preserve now; Week frame owns full behavior. |
| WEEK-08 | Shell links/campaign changes must not bypass existing pending-save/Confirmation departure protection. | Preserve/adapt now; Week frame owns ongoing feedback and barrier. |
| WEEK-12 | Valid campaign with no militia retains setup path; true campaign unavailability goes to shell; page failure has Try again. | Shared with Week frame. |
| SETUP-22, SETUP-23 | Hosted setup still has completed/loading/access behavior; preserve bookmarks and current startup behavior. | Shared with Setup, which delivers the later already-set-up page and layout skeleton. |
| HIST-02, HIST-03, HIST-07 | Keep previous/next/latest, selected audit entry and Earlier entries functional within the same campaign; adapt route inputs without changing the history query. Keep loading/failure/empty behavior. | Shell history-route adapter; Finished weeks owns record browsing and final states. |
| LEDG-01, LEDG-03, LEDG-05, LEDG-06, LEDG-09, LEDG-10 | Existing correction form, roster/officer/team-manager assignment, required reason, save/conflict behavior and pre-setup character access stay reachable. | Temporary shell hosting; Militia corrections and Characters & officers own replacements. |
| CHAR-01, CHAR-08, CHAR-09 | Existing CharacterManager stays reachable and reactive, including pre-setup, empty and archive states; campaign context is explicit. | Temporary shell hosting; Characters & officers owns full record/list/state behavior. |
| NAV-17 (new, planned) | Campaign-scoped routes and legacy redirects preserve campaign, phase and supported history selection with reload/Back/Forward coverage. | Shell; later routes build on this contract. |
| STATE-07 (new, planned) | Single neutral campaign-level sign-in/unavailable state with organization chooser and safe recovery. | Shell; all campaign pages consume it. |

**Approved removals/replacements only:** sidebar NAV-01 and placeholder navigation NAV-03 per [navigation approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/102#issuecomment-5831173561); NAV-09 mobile trigger replaced by bottom navigation per [responsive approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/120#issuecomment-5846493929); impossible **Select a campaign…** fragment of CHAR-09 per [shared-state approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/119#issuecomment-5846266381), with other character states retained; standalone `/militia/correct` address replaced by `/militia` per [correction approval](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/103#issuecomment-5834024251). No character fields, archive controls, correction fields, history/audit capabilities or in-flight protection are removed. Final record CRUD remains Characters & officers' ownership even where the existing widget temporarily appears on more than one page.

## 5. Data, payloads and rules

**No schema, query/mutation argument, result-shape or Weekly Resolution change. No Ruleset Version bump and no data migration.** All campaign authorization remains server-enforced; the shell's gate is presentation and avoids rendering protected page subscriptions before identity/active-organization access is established.

Use existing `campaign.getCampaigns` through `src/lib/sharedQueries.ts` for the active organization's campaign list, existing Clerk state for auth/organization, `cutover.status` for maintenance, and current page query/mutation contracts. Do not add `getCampaign(id)`, infer membership from a guessed id, automatically switch organizations, or adopt later approved backend changes early. In particular createCampaign's id return/description editing belong to Campaign list/home; finished-weeks listing belongs to Finished weeks; character kind/rules migration belongs to Characters & officers.

Read current integration seams: `src/app/layout.tsx`, `src/app/appSidebar.tsx`, `src/app/campaigns/*`, `src/app/canonical-*/page.tsx`, `src/components/campaign-dashboard.tsx`, `canonical-campaign-dashboard.tsx`, `campaign-selector.tsx`, `character-manager.tsx`, `use-canonical-ledger.ts`, `militia-setup/screen.tsx`, `historical-week/screen.tsx`, and `weekly-draft-workspace/board.tsx`. Reuse their controllers/hooks; don't fork the draft store or create a second active editor per campaign.

URL parsing and route-adapter props are client/navigation changes. Existing `canonicalHistory.read` already accepts `week`, `recordId`, `beforeSequence`; use those existing arguments for supported historical selection. Main currently keeps them in local `HistoryBrowser` state, so preserve that selection when adapting routes and browser history; do not claim old `/canonical-history` already interpreted those URL keys. Omitted history selection still opens the latest effective record. Validate numeric selectors structurally and leave record ownership to the existing backend. Malformed URL input cannot crash the shell or expose data.

A campaign/organization transition must discard old page-local subscriptions/views only through the existing pending-edit safeguards and must never retarget a delayed save to the next campaign. Phase changes remain local; don't persist phase in militia state. Existing snapshot, revision, stale-review, one-open-draft and immutable-history contracts remain untouched. Any extra backend change discovered in implementation requires the map's explicit human approval before proceeding with that change.

## 6. Validation and coverage

Retain **every existing `e2e/` scenario**. Update semantic navigation locators and helpers for links/bottom tabs and scoped addresses; keep legacy URL assertions as redirect tests instead of deleting their journeys. Preserve the auth harness and required-result gates; no skipping or weakening scenarios to accommodate the shell.

| Existing scenario | Equivalent behavior after shell delivery |
| --- | --- |
| `access.spec.ts` and `support/nightly-flows.ts` | Member campaign visibility versus outsider, supported campaign selection and full nightly character editing/reload journey. Existing Active campaign picker remains in the temporary list; future list owner rewrites it to rows. |
| `character-ledger.spec.ts` | Two players share character changes and persistent officer assignment with required correction reason; visit Characters & officers for records and the retained Militia correction editor for assignment. |
| `existing-militia.spec.ts` and `support/setup-workspace.ts` | Mid-campaign setup, fields/warnings/errors and starting phase survive navigation/reload in the correct campaign. |
| `realtime-action-slot.spec.ts` | Shared Action Slot staging and reload persistence; both contexts remain in their own local route/phase. |
| `complete-week.spec.ts` | Confirmation, next week, reload outcome and navigation to immutable history. |
| `canonical-workspace.spec.ts` and `support/activity-workspace.ts`, `event-workspace.ts`, `persistent-workspace.ts`, `persistent-qa.ts`, `summary-qa.ts` | Existing shared edits, independent phase navigation, pending departure warning, rejection/recovery, optimistic feedback, full phase decisions, warnings, Rules Exceptions, Table Adjustments, Confirmation, keyboard/tap/drag and responsive assertions. Phase redesign owners may later rewrite interactions with equivalent approved behavior. |
| `canonical-cutover.spec.ts` | Accepted source preserves canonical state/history after reload; retired backend paths still reject. These are unrelated to retaining old frontend bookmarks. |
| `canonical-persistence.spec.ts` and `canonical-confirmation.spec.ts` | Keep all direct Convex editing/Confirmation contracts, real auth/isolation, rollback, concurrent/stale review/delayed edits/dropped acknowledgements and historical-view assertions. They remain required although absent from most inventory E2E cells. |

Add focused shell/route acceptance checks for:

1. `/` and each legacy address, missing campaign, encoded campaign id, all valid phases, invalid phase fallback, valid history week/audit selection and reload/Back/Forward. New-history links choose the requested week without dropping the campaign or audit paging. Browser Back does not create a second draft store.
2. All four sections and Setup reachable at phone/tablet/desktop; normal/focused/active states; keyboard traversal; More opens/closes accessibly; visible content never disappears below fixed controls. No horizontal page scroll at test widths, including long campaign names and maintenance copy.
3. Signed-out, resolving-auth, invalid/deleted id, outsider, wrong active organization, no organization, no militia, page-query failure/retry and maintenance. A failed page leaves section navigation usable. An explicitly unavailable selected campaign never falls back to another campaign's data. The wrong-organization state offers selection; changing organization returns to its list, and reopening the bookmarked campaign then works if permitted.
4. Two members can independently navigate while seeing shared edits; section/campaign/organization navigation preserves pending-edit/Confirmation departure safety and does not leak one campaign's draft/history/characters into another. Realtime UI continues after reload.
5. Current create, character archive/unarchive, officer/roster correction, team-manager assignment and historical audit paging remain reachable before any later redesign. Pause keeps existing data readable; an attempted write shows the existing server pause failure through ordinary feedback.

Run `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint`, relevant local route/component tests, and the affected required/nightly E2E scenarios through the existing declared isolated-preview harness. Preserve direct contract checks. Report actual executed checks and environment limitations rather than treating unrun live-service coverage as passed. This issue's authoring does not require deploying or running the application.

## 7. Routes and rollout

| Route | Initial shell delivery | Later owner / compatibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/` | Redirect to `/campaigns`. | Keep existing home-navigation destination functional. |
| `/campaigns` | Existing campaign picker/create and empty states, inside list shell; navigation into selected campaign sections. | Campaign list/home replaces scaffold with approved list/detail layout. |
| `/campaigns/<id>` | Same scaffold with explicit selected campaign; no redirect and no duplicate embedded week. | Campaign list/home delivers final home pane. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/week?phase=…` | Host existing `CanonicalWorkspaceScreen` and its current phase editors once. Accept `upkeep`, `activity`, `event`, `persistent`, `summary`; invalid/absent phase falls back to Upkeep. Preserve existing Persistent Phase Eligibility enforcement. | Week frame replaces its chrome, then phase owners replace editors. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/history?week=<n>` | Host current historical browser; adapt selected week plus existing `recordId`/`beforeSequence` selection without changing query payload. Preserve latest/effective defaults, previous/next and audit paging. | Finished weeks replaces layout and adds its approved listing query. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/militia` | Host existing ledger/correction editor including roster, officers and managers; required reasons and current save/conflict behavior unchanged. CharacterManager may remain in this legacy host until its replacement is reachable on Characters & officers. | Militia corrections replaces sections; retains legacy roster/officer editing until Characters & officers ships. Managers stay with teams permanently. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/characters` | Host existing `CharacterManager` including create/edit/archive/unarchive/empty/error behavior; a clear link to **Militia** keeps the currently required roster/officer correction editor reachable. Before setup, character CRUD still works. | Characters & officers replaces the host with role cards/table and roster/officer corrections. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/setup` | Host existing setup form, its current validation/start flow and completed-page return link. | Setup delivers nine steps and the later **This militia is already set up.** page with Open week N/Open militia. |
| `/campaigns/<id>/militia/correct` | Do not introduce a new correction page; redirect an incoming address to `/campaigns/<id>/militia`. Existing correction control remains reachable there. | In-place correction address amendment. |
| `/canonical-workspace?campaign=X&phase=Y` | Redirect to `/campaigns/X/week?phase=Y`, then normalize invalid phase. | Preserve context; no legacy editor rendered. |
| `/canonical-setup?campaign=X` | Redirect to `/campaigns/X/setup`. | Started-militia bookmarks must still reach the setup state, not be forced to week by the redirect layer. |
| `/canonical-history?campaign=X` | Redirect to `/campaigns/X/history`; forward supported `week`, `recordId`, `beforeSequence` selection if present. | Existing route only read campaign; new adapter can represent already-supported browser/query selection. |
| Any above legacy route without campaign | Redirect to `/campaigns`. | Never assemble a guessed campaign address. |

No implementation blocker: this is the first shipping issue. Register a **native implementation dependency** from Week frame's output issue to this issue; later implementations follow the twelve-area shipping chain agreed in the rollout resolution. The authoring tasks are separate and are not runtime/implementation blockers. When their output issues exist, cross-link them by name.

Cutover from the old dashboard removes the duplicate embedded week only after the scoped week and corresponding links work. Do not remove existing correction/character controls merely because the final prototype omits them. The Militia roster/officer fallback ends only when the Characters & officers replacement supplies every equivalent operation with reason, validation, access and realtime behavior. Campaign picker/create fallback ends when Campaign list/home ships. Page-state refinements replace the existing page states in each area's delivery; central campaign access and maintenance apply immediately.

### Published implementation handoffs

This is the first implementation in the agreed rollout. The next shipping area is [Implement the shared Week frame and cross-device week transition](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/137). The native dependencies between implementation issues encode this shipping order; authoring tasks are already complete.

Other referenced implementation contracts: [Implement guided Militia Setup with browser resume](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/138), [Implement in-place Militia corrections and reference repair](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/139), [Implement Characters & officers with role corrections and compatible kind migration](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/141), [Implement Finished weeks with immutable records and paged audit history](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/146), [Implement the Campaign list and home with scoped creation and editing](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/147).

## 8. Shippable when

- All scoped routes, context-preserving old bookmarks and browser navigation work from a fresh load; `/campaigns/<id>` honors the approved list/home address. Only one week editor is mounted.
- Tablet top bar, phone bottom bar/More and desktop host are functional with theme/fonts intact, accessible controls and no clipped editors. Week-specific future controls have a clear Week frame handoff.
- Campaign access is checked before page contents render; signed-out/unavailable states are neutral and recoverable. Changing organization cannot expose stale campaign data. Maintenance keeps pages readable and existing write failure behavior intact. Page failures leave navigation usable.
- Every current editor, creation path, character operation, roster/officer/team-manager correction and audit control remains reachable through the documented temporary hosts; no schema/payload/rules drift or premature backend migration.
- Existing multiplayer, pending-save, Confirmation and history guarantees pass their equivalent scenarios. The capability inventory records shipped locations/coverage and retains the named downstream handoffs.
- `pnpm -s typecheck`, `pnpm -s lint` and relevant tests pass, with actual live E2E evidence reported for affected journeys and service contracts. No prototype branch is merged.
